purpose: Design of the eight SKILLs and two custom Agents in doc-link: responsibilities, use cases, per-SKILL sequences, the overall operating flow, and Agent data exchange.
summary: Eight SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) run inherited in the caller context and delegate logic to scripts
Table of which SKILLs write to indexed documents (only embed-dlid, DLID only) or rewrite management state (only index-docs)
Custom Agents toc-updater (info generation, up to 3 documents per launch) and query-worker (read-only search) with their responsibilities
Responsibilities of each operation and lookup SKILL, with links to requirements and design sections
Check SKILLs only detect and report; handling of findings by the project management AI is defined for check-links and check-impact
check-impact returns changed documents with direct referrers, recorded and current hashes, and no indirect referrers
Use case diagram and per-SKILL sequence diagrams for sections 3.1 to 3.8
Overall operating flow starting from check-dlid, then embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs, and check-impact
Data exchange with custom Agents: identifiers, request and result contents, error values, script validation, and deletion timing
tasks: Implementing or editing any doc-link SKILL.md
Implementing the toc-updater or query-worker custom Agent
Designing the order in which SKILLs are used
Deciding which SKILL may write to documents or state
Implementing check-links, check-toc, or check-impact handling
Implementing Agent request and result exchange scripts
Reviewing SKILL and Agent boundaries against requirements
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
